company.name: T7D Gaming
company.shortDescription: T7D Gaming is a MENA-focused gaming and esports platform that provides tournaments, gaming infrastructure, creator economy tools.
company.description: T7D Gaming is a Dubai-based gaming technology company building gaming infrastructure and esports ecosystems for the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. Founded in 2022, the company offers a gaming super-app that combines tournaments, live streaming, creator economy tools, rewards systems, and in-game commerce into a unified platform for gamers and developers. The platform supports casual and competitive gaming experiences while enabling players to earn and use digital currencies such as Galactic Dust (GD) across multiple games and services.
